name: Johann Georg Faust
source:
A mysterious priest in a church, in truth he is the legendary alchemist, rumored to have made a deal with the devil in his quest for knowledge. At first glance, he is quite the gentleman. However, his true nature is ruthless, performing morally questionable activities and experiments.
Though in service to Vlad, he continues his research night after night, in search of something...

"You have a very nice figure. You'd make an excellent guinea pig for my experiments."
